name: Game rule: units fight
source: library/tools/games/faeria.md, The game's rules (from sources): reduce the opponent's god to zero; a creature moves one tile and attacks an adjacent enemy (Wikipedia, Gameplay). Keyword Combat (faeria.com Keyword Rulings): a creature exchanges attacks with creatures, the enemy orb, or structures.

name: Game rule: units harvest
source: library/tools/games/faeria.md, The game's rules (from sources): 1 faeria for each faeria well you control by having a creature next to it (Wikipedia, Gameplay; Battlefield page). Claude's reading of the cards' words "an enemy well" / "an opponent's well": a well is mine or the enemy's; a unit harvests whichever well it stands next to.

name: Game rule: land is built next to my units
source: library/tools/games/faeria.md, The game's rules (from sources): a land goes on an empty ocean space next to your orb, a land you created, or a land one of your creatures stands on (Faeria wiki, Battlefield page; Kaptain 29 Oct 2026).

name: Game rule: creatures enter on my own empty land
source: library/tools/games/faeria.md, The game's rules (from sources): a creature is summoned on an empty land you created whose colour meets its land requirement (Faeria wiki, Battlefield page; Kaptain 29 Oct 2026).
